import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
import lightgbm as lgb
import os


# Haversine distance function
def haversine(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2):
    R = 6371  # Earth's radius in km
    lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2 = map(np.radians, [lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2])
    dlat = lat2 - lat1
    dlon = lon2 - lon1
    a = np.sin(dlat / 2) ** 2 + np.cos(lat1) * np.cos(lat2) * np.sin(dlon / 2) ** 2
    c = 2 * np.arcsin(np.sqrt(a))
    return R * c


# Load data
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
labels_df = pd.read_csv("./input/labels.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Merge labels with test data to form full dataset (since train features are in labels.csv)
train_df = labels_df.copy()

# Clean data
train_df = train_df[(train_df["fare_amount"] >= 0) & (train_df["fare_amount"] <= 500)]
train_df = train_df[
    (train_df["pickup_latitude"].abs() <= 90)
    & (train_df["pickup_longitude"].abs() <= 180)
]
train_df = train_df[
    (train_df["dropoff_latitude"].abs() <= 90)
    & (train_df["dropoff_longitude"].abs() <= 180)
]
train_df = train_df[
    (train_df["passenger_count"] >= 0) & (train_df["passenger_count"] <= 6)
]


# Feature engineering function
def add_features(df):
    # Distance
    df["distance"] = haversine(
        df["pickup_latitude"],
        df["pickup_longitude"],
        df["dropoff_latitude"],
        df["dropoff_longitude"],
    )
    # Time features
    df["pickup_datetime"] = pd.to_datetime(df["pickup_datetime"])
    df["hour"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.hour
    df["dayofweek"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.dayofweek
    df["month"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.month
    # Manhattan distance
    df["manhatten_dist"] = np.abs(
        df["pickup_latitude"] - df["dropoff_latitude"]
    ) + np.abs(df["pickup_longitude"] - df["dropoff_longitude"])
    return df


train_df = add_features(train_df)
test_df = add_features(test_df)

# Subsample for efficiency (using 1M rows)
train_df = train_df.sample(n=1000000, random_state=42)

# Features for model
features = [
    "pickup_latitude",
    "pickup_longitude",
    "dropoff_latitude",
    "dropoff_longitude",
    "passenger_count",
    "distance",
    "hour",
    "dayofweek",
    "month",
    "manhatten_dist",
]

# Split for validation
X = train_df[features]
y = train_df["fare_amount"]
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.1, random_state=42)

# Train LightGBM
train_data = lgb.Dataset(X_train, label=y_train)
val_data = lgb.Dataset(X_val, label=y_val, reference=train_data)
params = {
    "objective": "regression",
    "metric": "rmse",
    "verbosity": -1,
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "num_leaves": 63,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
}

model = lgb.train(
    params,
    train_data,
    num_boost_round=500,
    valid_sets=[val_data],
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=20), lgb.log_evaluation(period=0)],
)

# Validation RMSE
val_preds = model.predict(X_val)
val_rmse = np.sqrt(np.mean((val_preds - y_val) ** 2))
print(val_rmse)

# Predict test set
test_X = test_df[features]
test_preds = model.predict(test_X)

# Create submission using sample_submission format
submission = sample_sub[["key"]].copy()
submission["fare_amount"] = test_preds
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
